definitions.explanation: A compulsory financial charge imposed by a government.

examples.japanese: ⟦{消費税|しょうひぜい}→消費税：04803_shouhizei⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧10%⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{上|あ}がった→上がる：00615_agaru⟧。

examples.english: The price excluding tax is 900 yen.

notes:
COMMON TAX TYPES:
- ⟦{消費税|しょうひぜい}→消費税：04803_shouhizei⟧ (consumption tax, sales tax)
- ⟦{所得税|しょとくぜい}→所得税：04913_shotokuzei⟧ (income tax)
- ⟦{住民税|じゅうみんぜい}→住民税：16806_juuminzei⟧ (resident tax)
- {固定資産税|こていしさんぜい} (property tax)
- {相続税|そうぞくぜい} (inheritance tax)
- {贈与税|ぞうよぜい} (gift tax)

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {税|ぜい}{込|こ}み (tax included)
- {税|ぜい}{抜|ぬ}き (tax excluded, before tax)
- ⟦{税金|ぜいきん}→税金：03308_zeikin⟧ (tax, taxes - common word)
- ⟦{納税|のうぜい}→納税：13806_nouzei⟧ (tax payment)
- ⟦{脱税|だつぜい}→脱税：09000_datsuzei⟧ (tax evasion)
- ⟦{免税|めんぜい}→免税：09706_menzei⟧ (tax exemption, duty-free)
